title: Why not BC yet
intro: The idea started in British Columbia: the August 2023 Salmon River forage-water orders and the November 2021 Sumas Prairie flood. The ground data there is too thin to check a field-level answer, so the tool is built and tested in California first.

lines.label: No OpenET
lines.text: Field-scale measured crop water use covers western US states only.

lines.label: No field-soil API
lines.text: BC soil comes from survey polygons or a 250 m global model.

lines.label: One station per valley
lines.text: Salmon Arm CS is the only active daily weather station in its valley.

lines.label: Crop labels since 2011
lines.text: AAFC crop inventory starts in 2011, with thin BC ground sampling in 2021.

limit: BC is out of scope; transferability is a claim to test.

news.title: Fish population protection orders: about 398 licence holders told to stop watering forage crops
